answer_contract: preflight-selected from the frozen v1 answer-object candidates; one selected contract is reused across B/R/G

B.description: same model without attached document evidence

R.description: ordinary LlamaIndex BM25 ranked context, raw rank order truncated at 3072 bytes

G.description: same frozen LlamaIndex top12, then ExactScope precision-context-v5 fixed 3072B/cap8

primary_utility.answerable: token-normalized F1 against the scorer-side answer
primary_utility.unanswerable: 1 only for exact UNANSWERABLE disposition; otherwise 0
primary_utility.ambiguous: 1 only for exact AMBIGUOUS disposition; otherwise 0

safety.unsupported_assertion: on unanswerable or ambiguous gold, any non-null model answer other than the exact required disposition
safety.unacceptable_error: same as unsupported_assertion for this public proxy v0.1
safety.format_failure: frozen answer contract did not parse/validate

evidence_support.definition: at least one scorer-side support substring is present, after whitespace normalization, in the exact attached evidence payload for the arm

development_rule.note: development32 may reject the initial G candidate; the final selected G must be frozen before untouched-validation32 membership is served
